I answered from the docs (`docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, the index/types/service docs) and didn't open any source files, so line numbers come from the doc anchors. No schema change is needed: `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` are already on `characters`. ## Worker | File | Change | |---|---| | `worker/src/types/index.ts` (add near `ShopTransactionBody:159`) | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string }`. Add a cost constant, e.g. `INN_REST_COST`. A flat value is simplest; scaling by level is an alternative. | | `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. The handler does the following:
• Validate the body.
• Call `getCharacter`.
• Return 400 if `gold < cost`.
• Return 400 if `hp === max_hp`, so gold isn't wasted.
• Return 400 if the character is in combat (`CombatState` in the session).
• Call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, which allows only whitelisted fields).
• Return `{ updatedCharacter, cost }`.
• Optionally call `askDM` for narration, then `appendHistory` and `saveSession`.
• Optionally insert an `adventure_log` row.
Follow `routes/action.ts` as the template. | | `worker/src/index.ts` (route mounts, ~`:41-48`) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. | | `worker/src/services/*.ts` (optional) | Only if the cost or heal logic is shared with another route, put it in a service rather than the route. | Check that `updateCharacter` whitelists both `hp` and `gold`. If either is missing, add it in `services/character.ts`. ## Frontend | File | Change | |---|---| | `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse { updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number; narrative?: string }` interface. It mirrors the Worker response. | | `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gold)" button next to the Inventory button (`:9`). Disable it when `inCombat()`, when `hp === max_hp`, or when `gold < cost`. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `restAtInn()` handler that:
• calls `GameApiService.rest`;
• calls `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`;
• pushes a system or narrative entry;
• reads errors from `err.error.error`.
Mirror the cost constant here, or return it from the API. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy: success, insufficient gold, and the disabled states. | `CharacterStateService` needs no code change, because `setCharacter` already updates the sheet and HP bar. ## Docs to update in the same change - The doc beside each changed file, plus a new `docs/code/worker/src/routes/rest.md`. - `docs/code/worker/src/index.md`, for the route mounts table and its connections. - `docs/code/worker/src/types/index.md`, for the `RestBody` anchors. - `docs/code/frontend/src/app/models/game.models.md`, `docs/code/frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.md`, and the game-console doc. - `code.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`. - `docs/PRD.md` §9, for the API spec. - A new `docs/flows/rest.md`, or a section in `docs/flows/inventory.md`, plus the `AGENTS.md` routing table if you add a flow doc. ## Related issues - Potions only change HP in the browser and never save it (B-05). Rest will be the first feature that persists healing through `updateCharacter`, so make sure the two don't conflict. - CORS needs no change, because the origins are already allowed.
